title: HybridResearcher: Bridging the Structured-Unstructured Boundary for Deep Research Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.24899v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While LLM agents are increasingly capable of gathering and synthesizing evidence from a single homogeneous source, such as structured tables or unstructured data, real-world analytical questions frequently span heterogeneous sources. For example, answering one enterprise question may require both a result computed over an internal database and evidence found on the web. Recent evaluations on benchmarks like HybridDeepResearch show that even frontier agents struggle when evidence must cross this boundary. While these benchmarks have exposed the limitation, methodologies to explicitly teach cross-source reasoning remain absent. To address this, we introduce HybridResearcher, a 4B agent trained to bridge evidence across the structured and unstructured boundary. translated_title: HybridResearcher：为深度研究智能体打通结构化与非结构化数据的边界
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.24899v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：尽管大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越擅长从单一同质来源（如结构化表格或非结构化数据）中收集和综合证据，但现实世界中的分析问题往往跨越异构来源。例如，回答一个企业问题可能既需要基于内部数据库计算的结果，也需要在网络上找到的证据。最近在 HybridDeepResearch 等基准上的评估表明，即使是前沿智能体在证据需要跨越这一边界时也会表现不佳。虽然这些基准已经暴露了这一局限，但目前仍然缺乏明确教授跨来源推理的方法。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 HybridResearcher，一个经过训练、能够在结构化与非结构化数据边界之间搭建证据桥梁的 4B 智能体。为了构建它，我们从经过验证的单源任务（如现有的文本到 SQL 或网络搜索查询）出发，人工合成跨来源的桥接轨迹……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出 HybridResearcher——一个 4B 参数的深度研究智能体，通过从已验证的单源任务合成跨来源桥接轨迹来训练，使其学会在结构化数据与非结构化数据的边界之间进行跨源证据推理与整合。
en_tdlr: HybridResearcher is a 4B deep research agent trained on synthesized cross-source bridge trajectories derived from validated single-source tasks, enabling it to reason and integrate evidence across the structured-unstructured data boundary.
